fix_review.contract_basis: FIX-T1-R2.md requires complete expected pointer shape/identity, including valid target ID and intended relative target, before replacing a prior pointer; CONTRACT.md requires managed pointers atomically replaced only after validating expected schema/identity. Valid old pointers may be replaced by a newer valid target after their own referenced bundle is validated.

fix_review.pointer_identity_evidence: _valid_current_pointer(existing) checks only schema, view_id syntax and self-consistent index_relative; _publish_json_pointer does not validate that the existing pointer references an actual validated view bundle before replacing it. _valid_heads_pointer likewise checks only syntax, not referenced record bundles. A prior valid pointer may legitimately be replaced by a new target, so equality with the new target_id is not required.
fix_review.reproduction: With a valid built view, replace knowledge/CURRENT.json with canonical valid self-consistent pointer for view_id=f*64 and index_relative=knowledge/views/<f*64>/index.md, while that view bundle is absent. build_knowledge_views returned ok=True,status=OK,reused=True and replaced the forged pointer instead of closing/preserving it.
